decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game through various counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. Ertai Resurrected serves as the commander, allowing for repeated sacrifices of creatures to counter spells. The deck includes a mix of creature removal like Fatal Push and Toxic Deluge, counterspells such as Cryptic Command and Force of Will, and card draw spells like Fact or Fiction and Brainstorm. With a strong mana base including fetch lands like Polluted Delta and Misty Rainforest, the deck aims to out-value and out-control the opponent, eventually winning through incremental advantage or with powerful finishers like Torrential Gearhulk. The strategy revolves around disrupting the opponent's game plan while ensuring card advantage and mana efficiency.

This deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, backed up by a variety of burn spells and tempo disruption. The main strategy is to apply steady pressure on the opponent with cheap and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Kari Zev, Skyship Raider, and Young Pyromancer. Support cards like Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Forked Bolt help to clear the way for attacks or finish off the opponent. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Mana Leak to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to maintain a fast pace of play, overwhelming the opponent before they can stabilize and take control of the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing Prossh, Skyraider of Kher as a powerful combo commander. The key strategy is to generate high amounts of tokens and sacrifice them for various benefits, triggering abilities like Goblin Bombardment, Blood Artist, and Purphoros, God of the Forge for massive damage. The deck also includes cards for ramp, removal, and card advantage to support the combo strategy. By efficiently sacrificing creatures and using the commander's abilities, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and finish the game with a powerful combo finish. With a strong synergy between sacrificing tokens and triggering powerful effects, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield in a fast-paced Duel Commander game.

The deck is focused on utilizing Raffine, Scheming Seer as the commander to implement a control and aggro strategy. The key concept revolves around a mix of disruption, card advantage, and proactive creatures to pressure the opponent. The deck includes various efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, Fatal Push, and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats, while also running counterspells such as Force of Will and Mana Leak to protect its game plan. Additionally, strong creatures like True-Name Nemesis and Skyclave Apparition provide a clock for the opponent while generating value. The deck aims to control the board early on and then disrupt the opponent's game plan with efficient threats to secure victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's plans with various counter spells and removal spells. Davros, Dalek Creator is the commander who helps generate card advantage and maintain control over the battlefield. This deck focuses on a mix of permission spells, card draw, and removal to keep the opponent at bay while establishing a powerful board presence with creatures like True-Name Nemesis and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. By carefully managing resources and countering key threats, this deck aims to out-value the opponent and secure a victory by overwhelming them with powerful spells and creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively overwhelm the opponent with a variety of low-cost creatures and spells, along with graveyard recursion and sacrifice effects to continuously pressure the opponent. Judith, the Scourge Diva, serves as the commander and provides additional damage whenever creatures die. The deck includes a mix of efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Knight of the Ebon Legion, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to control the board. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Reanimate and Demonic Tutor to bring back key threats or find specific answers when needed. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive playstyle with a balanced mix of lands and color sources.

The concept of this deck is to utilize Raffine, Scheming Seer as the commander in a Duel Commander 1 vs 1 format and focus on an aggressive playstyle. The deck includes a combination of disruptive spells, efficient creatures, and powerful control elements to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy through counter magic, removal spells, and card advantage. By efficiently deploying threats and interacting with the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to outpace and overwhelm the opponent to secure victory in a fast-paced and dynamic gameplay environment.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while also deploying threats that can quickly close out the game. With a mix of powerful counter spells like Force of Will and Mana Leak, removal like Swords to Plowshares and Fatal Push, and disruptive creatures like Spell Queller and True-Name Nemesis, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot. Raffine, Scheming Seer serves as a versatile commander that can provide card advantage and potentially reanimate key threats. The mana base is optimized to ensure smooth color fixing and the ability to cast spells on curve. Overall, the deck is built to be proactive and aggressive, aiming to pressure the opponent while maintaining control of the game.
